faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What e-commerce platforms do you support?
faq.a1: We support Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, Salla, Zid, Etsy, Noon, Wix, Squarespace, and BigCommerce. Our system also works with most sites that use standard product markup.
faq.q2: How long does it take to generate a video?
faq.a2: A single video typically renders in under 60 seconds. Bulk jobs process multiple videos in parallel for faster throughput.
faq.q3: What video formats can I export?
faq.a3: You can export in three formats: 9:16 (Stories/Reels/TikTok), 1:1 (Feed posts), and 16:9 (YouTube/Web).
faq.q4: Can I customize the generated videos?
faq.a4: Yes! You can edit the AI-generated script, change colors, reorder images, select background music, and switch between 5 professional templates.
faq.a5: We support English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Turkish, Chinese, and Hindi with automatic language detection and full RTL support.
faq.q6: What happens if I exceed my render limit?
faq.a6: You can purchase additional renders at $0.50 each, or upgrade your plan for a higher monthly allowance.
